proof_0529.moves: Instance derivation: the category of schemes has a terminal object (Spec Z) and pullbacks (fibre products of schemes), so the general criterion that terminal + pullbacks gives all finite limits applies.

proof_0530.moves: Rewrite the first marginal of a kernel as the pushforward of the kernel along Prod.fst (fst_eq), then the zero-or-Markov property is inherited by the map instance.

proof_0531.moves: SL(n,R) sits inside the matrix space as a subtype, and a subspace of a discrete space is discrete; the actual argument is hidden in an auto-generated private proof obligation.

proof_0532.moves: The two sides of the intersection equation are definitionally equal, so the proof is a reflexivity certificate emitted by simp/decide after unfolding ExtTreeMap.inter.

proof_0533.moves: Build the IsWellOrder structure for the relation pulled back along an injection: trichotomy transfers because f is injective, and well-foundedness/transitivity transfer along the pullback.

proof_0534.moves: Both sides unfold to the same underlying bit vector, so the identity holds by definitional reflexivity.

proof_0535.moves: From a <= b, ExistsAddOfLE produces c with b = a + c; substituting back gives a <= a + c, from which left-cancellation of <= yields 0 <= c, and the pair (c, proof) is the witness.

proof_0536.moves: The numeral cast into Int16 and its bit-vector projection reduce to the same term, so the lemma is reflexivity.

proof_0537.moves: Unfold the evaluation of the succ code on an input list: it takes the head (with default 0) and adds one, so the result is Part.some [n+1]; closed by definitional simplification.

proof_0538.moves: Unfold IsLoopAt, Inc and IsNonloopAt to their underlying incidence statements, then the equivalence is pure propositional manipulation: push the negation through the conjunction/existential and cancel a double negation.

proof_0539.moves: FreeMonoid over a type is by definition the list type and toList is the identity equivalence, so pushing a generator onto a word is literally list cons; the proof is reflexivity.

proof_0540.moves: Case split on the option: for none both sides are false, for some a the attached value is the subtype element with the same underlying value, so both sides reduce to p a; each branch closes by reflexivity.

proof_0541.moves: This is the reassociated variant of the associator naturality lemma: take the base identity, post-compose (whisker) it with an arbitrary further morphism, and reassociate the composite using associativity of composition.

proof_0542.moves: A set in the order dual is a lower set exactly when its preimage under toDual is an upper set; the proof takes the reverse direction of that characterisation.

proof_0543.moves: Structural induction on the list of union-find nodes: for the empty list membership is impossible, and for a cons the member is either the head (bounded by max on the left) or in the tail (bounded via the inductive hypothesis and max on the right).

proof_0544.moves: Chain the hypothesis a <= b + c with the fact that adding a nonpositive element only decreases, b + c <= b, using transitivity of <=.

proof_0545.moves: Pure forwarding: the claim is exactly the defining field of the IsCocomm class, so the proof projects that field out of the hypothesis.

proof_0546.moves: Membership in the opposite of a set is defined as membership of the unopped element in the original set, so the equivalence is true by definition (Iff.rfl).

proof_0547.moves: Assemble the SubgroupClass instance for Subgroup by supplying its three closure fields: multiplicative closure and the identity come from the underlying submonoid/subsemigroup structure, and inverse closure from the subgroup's own field.

proof_0548.moves: Identify the image of the fibre-mk map with the fibre's image set (the preimage of a singleton), using the canonical self-map into the fibre; the proof is the cited identification read backwards.

proof_0549.moves: Reassociated form of the comonad coassociativity law in a bicategory: take comul_assoc and whisker it with an arbitrary further 2-morphism, reassociating the composite with associativity of composition.

proof_0550.moves: Case split on the option: none gives the empty list so the fold returns the initial value, some a gives a one-element list so the fold returns f b a; each branch is reflexivity.

proof_0551.moves: Casting a morphism along two reflexivity proofs does nothing definitionally, so the statement is closed by rfl.

proof_0552.moves: Weaken the predecessor-limit hypothesis to a predecessor-prelimit and apply the prelimit version of the strict inequality a - 1 < a.
